size.$description: Sizes that differ by platform: the input decides them, since touch needs larger targets than a pointer (decisions/0010, chapter 06). Every platform's file names the same tokens with the same descriptions; only the values differ.

s.$description: The height of a control at size s: 24 on macOS, 32 on iOS, iPadOS and watchOS. On touch platforms it is below the recommended target, so its hit area stays the target's size (chapter 08).

use: control in a toolbar or a table row
dev.westron.usage.avoid: The default size: use size.control.m. A row's height: rows have heights of their own.

m.$description: The height of a control at the default size m: a button, a field, a segmented control. 32 on macOS, westron's control (decisions/0013); 44 on iOS, iPadOS and watchOS, the touch target (chapter 08).

dev.westron.usage.avoid: A row's height: rows have heights of their own. A fixed height where text can grow: the height is a minimum.

l.$description: The height of a control at size l: the one prominent action of a form, a sheet or an empty state. 40 on macOS, 52 on iOS, iPadOS and watchOS.

dev.westron.usage.avoid: Every control on a screen: the large size marks the one action that leads.
